decree.agent_cli_never: The agent does not start agent CLIs through the shell ("{{command}}"): characters are born only through the engine, from sheets and bases.
decree.allow_all: "{{pattern}}" allows everything, which includes the vault, the files of the Mestre and the agent CLIs, which an agent never gets; the decree is refused.
decree.author_not_user: The author of the order is not a user of the Mestre.
decree.behavior_too_long: A behavior is a short instruction of up to 500 characters.
decree.ceiling_needs_allow: Raising the ceiling needs to say what the ceiling now allows.
decree.class_built_in: The `orquestrador` class is built into the binary: no decree changes its fields, its fixed rules or its files.deny; a decree can allow or forbid an action to the orchestrators, as to any character.
decree.class_not_edited: A decree does not edit a class: the class changes through `mestre class`, and the decree changes the effective rule.
decree.delegation_scope_unknown: The scope of a delegation is the table, `classe:<name>` or `repo:<owner/name>`; "{{scope}}" is not understood.
decree.delegation_type_not_allowed: Type not delegable: "{{type}}"; the Grand Master decides only the high-risk types under a `delegation` decree (the entry into the Guild, the promotion of the Citadel and the cost above the ceiling never).
decree.delegation_validity_max: A delegation lasts 30 days at most (asked: until {{until}}).
decree.effect_unknown: Unknown effect: "{{effect}}" (the effects are permission, behavior, policy, ceiling and delegation).
decree.exception_exact_action: A one-off exception allows one exact action.
decree.exception_state_unreadable: The state the exception is tied to could not be read: {{reason}}
decree.file_never: The agent never gets "{{file}}": these are hook and configuration files of the Mestre or the vault, which only the engine touches; the decree is refused.
decree.kind_invalid: The kind of a decree is a permanent rule or a one-off exception.
decree.no_verify: The target could not be verified.
decree.operator_delegation_owner_only: Delegating the Operator's activation is for the Guildmaster only: {{reason}}
decree.operator_minutes: Each delegated activation lasts up to {{minutes}} minutes.
decree.operator_scope_required: The delegation of the Operator's activation needs a scope: `missao:<name>` or `classe:<name>`.
decree.operator_validity_required: The delegation of the Operator's activation must have a validity of 7 days at most.
decree.permission_kinds: A permission allows or forbids files, commands, tools or domains.
decree.policy_github_protection: Not even the engine can get around the protection of GitHub ({{setting}}): the decree is refused.
decree.policy_loosen_area: Loosening the policy needs a sensitive area (such as migracoes) or a type of medium risk; "{{setting}}" is not one (the areas of the engine and of the secrets are never opened).
decree.policy_needs_type: A policy decree says the type of request or the condition it adjusts.
decree.policy_not_loosened: A policy decree does not loosen the type "{{setting}}" (high or fixed risk); for the Grand Master to decide a high type, only a `delegation` decree from the Guildmaster (docs/aprovacoes/delegacao.md).
decree.policy_target: A policy decree applies to the campaign, the table or the class, not to a character.
decree.policy_tighten_type: Tightening the policy needs a type of request (such as acao_destrutiva) or * for all; "{{setting}}" is not one.
decree.scope_required: The delegation needs a scope: the table, `classe:<name>` or `repo:<owner/name>`.
decree.sub_beyond_origin: The subdelegation does not go beyond its origin (decree {{number}}, until {{until}}).
decree.sub_grand_master_only: Only the Grand Master subdelegates; the Mestre of a table does not pass on what it received.
decree.sub_no_origin: The Grand Master has no delegation from the Guildmaster for "{{type}}" on table "{{mesa}}": there is nothing to subdelegate.
decree.sub_origin_ended: The delegation of origin is over.
decree.sub_own_table_only: The subdelegation is for the Mestre of table "{{mesa}}", on that table only.
decree.sub_table_not_open: The table "{{mesa}}" is not open: a subdelegation never outlasts the table.
decree.sub_validity_too_long: The validity of a subdelegation is 30 days at most, and never beyond its origin.
decree.target_changed: The target changed since the approval; the exception expired unused.
decree.target_kind: The target is a class, a character, a campaign or a table.
decree.target_workspace_mismatch: The campaign target "{{target}}" is not the scope "{{workspace}}".
decree.text_required: The proposal needs the original text of the order.
decree.vault_never: The agent never has access to the vault ("{{command}}").
decree.workspace_not_yours: The campaign "{{workspace}}" is not among yours.
decree.wrong_request: The request offered is not the one the exception was made for.
